steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Function: A rule that takes an input (x) and gives exactly one output. Written as f(x), g(x), etc. | Key terms: Domain: All possible input values Range: All possible output values

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Given f(x) = 4x - 3, find f(5) and f(-2). | Given g(x) = x² - 1, find g(3) and g(x + 1). | Find the inverse of f(x) = 2x - 7.
